name: meshmoose
description: MeshMoose.ai — multimodal reconstruction with Zoo APIs

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && sh -c 'if [ -x ../../.venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then exec ../../.venv/bin/uvicorn meshmoose_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787; else exec uvicorn meshmoose_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787; fi'
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && sh -c 'if [ -x ../../.venv/bin/pytest ]; then exec ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q; else exec pytest -q; fi'
